node.title: Re: Loading a part of the file to array using Tie::File (don't)
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext:
But this could eat a lot of memory, as the files are huge. So I found Tie::File online, that happens not to load arrays in memory. 1st question, is that correct ?

Hi ansh007

Apparently Tie::File doesn't fast big files well it slow :D Don't use Tie::File its a toy :)

  • [id://985818|I hate to be there bearer of bad tidings here, but if you'd ever tried using Tie::File on a 34GB file, you'd never be suggesting it to others. It would take weeks to complete. ]
  • [id://985838|Oh, this is sad. I just had the script work on a 1G+ file, and extrapolated the time to about 17hrs of processing for a 34G file. ]
  • [id://1056018|Using Tie::File on such a huge file -- or any file over a few (single digit) megabytes is stupid. It will use huge amounts of cpu and be very slow. ]
  • [id://1039685|a file size that is too large to use with Tie::File? 1000 lines/100kB]
  • [id://894614|Please do not suggest the use of Tie::File for use with files bigger than a few tens of megabytes. Using it makes processing such files 10s or 100s of times slower than using normal line-by-line access for no benefit. ]
  • [id://865023|Please try this yourself--say read the middle line in a 1 or 2GB file--before suggesting it to others. ]
  • [id://850539|Tie::File is slow, to write a 1mb file 137.506 seconds, versus 0.197 seconds without it]
  • [id://829651|Tie::File: Speed and memory issue with large files]
